info.name: Teya FX Captures Pay at Table API

params.name: status
params.description:
Tab statuses to include. Repeatable (e.g., `status=OPEN&status=PAUSED`).
When omitted, returns only active tabs (`OPEN`, `PAYING`, `PAUSED`).
To include archived tabs, pass `status=COMPLETED` and/or `status=CLOSED` explicitly.

params.name: merchant_reference
params.description: Merchant-assigned reference to filter by. When provided, returns the single tab matching (store_id, merchant_reference) or an empty list.

params.name: after
params.description: Opaque cursor pointing to the last item of the current page. Use to fetch the next page. Mutually exclusive with `before`.

params.name: before
params.description: Opaque cursor pointing to the first item of the current page. Use to fetch the previous page. Mutually exclusive with `after`.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 50, capped at 300.

items.docs:
Returns tabs for the specified store, cursor-paginated.

Supports optional filters:
- `status`: repeatable. When omitted, defaults to active tabs only
  (`OPEN`, `PAYING`, `PAUSED`). To include archived tabs, pass
  `status=COMPLETED` and/or `status=CLOSED` explicitly.
- `merchant_reference`: merchant-assigned reference. Unique per store, so the
  filtered response will contain at most one tab.
Creates a new tab for a store. The tab starts in OPEN status.

Terminal signals intent to display the bill for a tab. The server accepts
the intent and notifies the ePOS via a `SHOW_BILL_REQUEST` SSE event, which
in turn posts bill content back to the server. At most one terminal can hold
an active show-bill intent per tab at a time.

Terminal initiates a payment intent for a tab. The tab transitions to
`PAYING` if it is in `OPEN` or `PAUSED`; PAYING tabs are no-op idempotent.
On a `PAUSED → PAYING` transition POSLink auto-emits a `TAB_RESUMED` SSE
event before the `PAY_REQUEST`. The ePOS then calls POST /v3/payment-requests
(with tab_id and payment_type) to materialise the payment. Supports FULL and
SPLIT payment types with CARD or CASH methods.

Records a pause event on the tab. Strict semantics: only a tab in
`PAYING` status can be paused — pause is a mid-split-payment
operation. On success the tab moves to `PAUSED` and the ePOS
receives a `TAB_PAUSED` SSE event.

Terminal signals intent to stop displaying the bill for a tab. Strict
semantics: the lock must currently be held by the calling terminal —
a hide racing the credit-completed path or the TTL sweeper is rejected
with `409 TAB_NO_ACTIVE_SHOW_BILL`. On success the server clears the
show-bill state on the tab and notifies the ePOS via a
`TAB_BILL_HIDDEN` SSE event.

Reports an error from the ePOS for a specific tab (e.g., table not found, bill already settled).
The server accepts the rejection and notifies the affected terminal so it can surface
the error to the operator.

info.name: Retrieve the current bill for a tab

items.docs: Returns the current bill for a tab, including items, amounts, and bill image URL (if any). If the ePOS has reported a rejection via POST /v1/tabs/{tab_id}/errors before any bill content was posted, the response still returns 200 with the bill fields empty/zero and last_error_* populated so the terminal can surface the error to the user.

info.name: Send bill content to the server

items.docs:
ePOS pushes bill content for a tab. The server accepts the content and
forwards it to the terminal currently holding the active show-bill intent.

Two request-body variants are supported, selected by `Content-Type`:
- `application/json` — a structured `print_model` (see `ShowBillRequest`).
- `multipart/form-data` — a pre-rendered bill image (PNG or JPEG) with
  `terminal_id`, `total_amount` and `currency` form fields.
Returns full details of a single tab including items and payment requests.

Applies an ePOS content amend to the tab (total amount and/or items).
All body fields are optional; only the ones provided are applied. The tab
must be in a state that accepts content amends (typically OPEN).

Tab lifecycle transitions (pause, resume, complete) are expressed as
dedicated sub-resources, not via this endpoint. Closing a tab is done
via DELETE /v1/tabs/{tab_id}.

Soft-deletes a tab by setting its status to CLOSED. The tab record is retained.
Allowed source states: `OPEN`, `COMPLETED`, `PAUSED`. Closing a `PAYING` tab
is rejected because a transaction is mid-flight; drive it to a stable state
first (resume or pause). Closing a `PAUSED` tab is allowed — if a late
payment-completed event lands on the now-CLOSED tab, the credit is logged
and counted via `eposconnect.tabs.credit.on_closed_tab.count` for ops

info.name: Stream tab events for a store

items.docs:
Streams real-time tab events for a store using Server-Sent Events (SSE).

Event types: SHOW_BILL_REQUEST, PAY_REQUEST, TAB_PAYMENT_STATUS_PROGRESS,
TAB_PAYMENT_COMPLETED, TAB_PAUSED, TAB_RESUMED, TAB_COMPLETED, TAB_BILL_HIDDEN.

Each event frame carries:
- `event:` line — the event type (matches the JSON `event_type` discriminator).
- `id:` line — a per-store monotonic event id used for `Last-Event-ID` reconnection.
